text:

name: org-lists
text:
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil author:nil
* Lists
- one
- two
  - nested a
  - nested b
- three

1. first
2. second
   continued here
3. third

- [ ] open task
- [X] done task
- [-] partial

- term :: its description
- another term :: another description
  with a second line

name: org-tables
text:
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil author:nil
* Tables
| Name  | Qty | Price |
|-------+-----+-------|
| Apple |   3 |  1.50 |
| Pear  |  12 |  0.75 |
|-------+-----+-------|
| Total |  15 |       |

#+CAPTION: Small table
| a | b |
| c | d |

| <l> | <r>  |
| left | right |
| x | 10 |

name: org-blocks
text:
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil author:nil
* Blocks
#+BEGIN_SRC python
def f(x):
    return x + 1
#+END_SRC

#+BEGIN_EXAMPLE
  example text
    indented
#+END_EXAMPLE

#+BEGIN_QUOTE
A quotation that runs on for a little while, long enough to need filling when it is exported to plain text.
#+END_QUOTE

#+BEGIN_CENTER
Centred text
#+END_CENTER

#+BEGIN_VERSE
  Roses are red,
    violets are blue.
#+END_VERSE

: fixed width line
: another one

-----

#+BEGIN_note
A special block.
#+END_note

#+BEGIN_COMMENT
Not exported.
#+END_COMMENT
# a comment line
After the comment.

name: org-footnotes
text:
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil author:nil
* Notes
Text with a footnote[fn:1] and another[fn:named].
An inline one[fn:: Inline definition.] too.
Again the first[fn:1].

[fn:1] The first footnote.

[fn:named] The named footnote,
with two lines.

name: org-links
text:
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil author:nil
* Links
See [[https://example.com][Example]] and https://plain.example.org/path.
A bare [[https://example.com/bare]] link.
A file [[file:notes.org][notes]] and [[file:image.png]].
Go to [[*Target heading]] or [[#custom][custom]] or <<here>>a target, see [[here]].
* Target heading
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: custom
:END:
Arrived.

name: org-todo
text:
#+OPTIONS: toc:nil author:nil
* TODO [#A] Write the report                                  :work:urgent:
SCHEDULED: <2026-11-28 Sat> DEADLINE: <2026-11-30 Mon>
Body of the task.
* DONE Finished thing                                         :home:
CLOSED: [2026-11-26 Thu 10:00]
* Plain heading
:PROPERTIES:
:EFFORT:   1:00
:END:
:LOGBOOK:
- Note taken on [2026-11-20 Fri 09:00]
:END:
Text with <2026-12-01 Tue> and [2026-12-02 Wed 14:00].

name: org-wrapping
text:
